title: Sources: UK-based Google DeepMind staff urge leaders to drop non-disparagement clauses barring public warnings about AI risks even after they leave the company (Gerrit De Vynck/Washington Post)
summary: Gerrit De Vynck / Washington Post: Sources: UK-based Google DeepMind staff urge leaders to drop non-disparagement clauses barring public warnings about AI risks even after they leave the company — Employment contracts deter staff from warning the public about AI risks, current workers said. — SummaryLoading...
